title: النِّصالُ عَلى النِّصالِ
source_note: Verses 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 are copied character-for-character from the text supplied by the user. Verse 4 (وَهانَ...) is recited in the uploaded video but was not in the supplied text; it is taken from the canonical diwan text of the same poem (al-Mutanabbi, rithaa' of Sayf al-Dawla's mother, 'نُعِدُّ المَشرَفِيَّةَ وَالعَوالي'), using the same orthographic conventions as the supplied verses, and cross-checked against the subtitles burned into the uploaded video. The supplied verses 'وَمَن لَم يَعشَقِ الدُنيا قَديماً' and 'نَصيبُكَ في حَياتِكَ مِن حَبيبٍ' are NOT recited in the uploaded video and therefore are not subtitled.
